meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: World Champions: France 1998, Vietnam v Netherlands | Group E | FIFA Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023, Argentina v Serbia and Montenegro | Group C | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Italy v France | Germany 2006
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
